description.value: Charlie Don't Surf has been a fixture on the White Rock waterfront strip since 1985, serving fresh wild seafood alongside local organic vegetables and a broad selection of craft beers. Situated on Marine Drive directly adjacent to White Rock Beach, it draws both locals and visitors looking for a casual seaside meal. The restaurant also operates a bar and offers outdoor seating, making it a natural rest point for cyclists riding the waterfront.
